categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of blood purification equipment and consumables, as well as providing chain blood dialysis medical services. Its main products include continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT) devices, hemodialysis machines, blood perfusion machines, dialysis concentrates, dialyzers, filters, blood purification tubing sets, and disposable blood perfusion devices. The company also operates multiple chain blood dialysis centers and offers intelligent blood dialysis management systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies in blood purification equipment, including multi-organ support systems integrating dialysis, filtration, and adsorption technologies. It has advanced liquid balance feedback control, precision peristaltic pump control, dual-channel replacement fluid input, and non-invasive temperature measurement technologies. The company also innovates in consumables such as dialyzers with optimized fiber membrane structures and adsorption materials. Production employs intelligent manufacturing systems integrating ERP, PLM, MES, and quality control to ensure product consistency and traceability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include large tertiary hospitals (over 400 in China), regional hospitals, and international medical institutions. The company serves end markets of chronic kidney disease patients, especially those with end-stage renal disease (ESRD), and critically ill patients requiring blood purification therapies. Its products and services are used in nephrology, intensive care units (ICU), and multi-organ failure treatment. International markets include over 90 countries across Asia, Europe, Africa, and the Americas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Chongqing and multiple subsidiaries and dialysis centers across the country. It has a growing international presence with sales and installations in over 90 countries including Indonesia, Thailand, India, Greece, Switzerland, Russia, Mexico, and South Africa. The company is expanding its global sales and service networks, focusing on emerging markets and key regions such as Southeast Asia, Middle East, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the blood purification supply chain. It develops and manufactures blood purification equipment and consumables (midstream) and provides medical services through its chain dialysis centers (downstream). It also integrates intelligent management systems linking equipment, consumables, healthcare providers, and patients, creating a comprehensive blood purification ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes autonomous innovation and technology leadership, investing heavily in R&D with a 42.62% increase in spending in 2024. It focuses on developing new blood purification devices, consumables, and intelligent management systems, incorporating AI and digital technologies to enhance device automation, safety, and personalized treatment. The company actively participates in national and industry standards development and pursues international certifications such as CE. Future R&D emphasizes expanding product lines, improving device intelligence, and integrating clinical data platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales and distribution of blood purification equipment and consumables. The company employs a combination of direct sales and buyout distribution models domestically, and mainly distribution channels internationally. It also earns revenue from providing blood dialysis medical services through its chain centers. Additional income comes from after-sales services, maintenance, and digital platform subscriptions related to intelligent management systems.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in China's blood purification equipment market, ranking first among domestic brands in blood dialysis machines and CRRT devices. Major international competitors include Fresenius, Baxter, B. Braun, Nikkiso, and JMS. The company holds a significant market share domestically and is recognized for its technological innovation and comprehensive product portfolio, positioning it as a key competitor driving import substitution in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 567 million, a 17.8% decrease from 2023, mainly due to policy-driven fluctuations in high-margin CRRT product sales. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 70.9 million, down 63.55%. Excluding non-recurring items, net profit declined 67.53%. Despite short-term declines, the company maintains a three-year compound annual growth rate of 26.05% in revenue. Cash flow from operations increased by 121.75%, reflecting improved operational stability. Total assets reached RMB 2.01 billion with a slight increase year-over-year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary core technologies, comprehensive product lines, and integrated blood purification ecosystem combining equipment, consumables, medical services, and intelligent management. Its products feature advanced multi-organ support capabilities, high precision control, and safety features exceeding industry standards. The company’s focus on innovation, quality, and localized manufacturing enables cost-effective solutions that reduce treatment costs significantly, enhancing accessibility for patients. Its strong R&D capabilities, national certifications, and international approvals differentiate it as a trusted and competitive brand in both domestic and global markets.
